AIoT Engineer Roadmap v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a platform to generate personalized AI + IoT engineering career roadmaps based on user assessment.
- Offers structured learning paths, specialization guidance, and curated resources for engineers at any stage.
- Provides endpoints to generate roadmaps, fetch available specializations, and access a catalog of learning paths.
- Includes flexible pricing plans for individuals and organizations.
- Designed for career planners, managers, and engineers seeking targeted professional growth in AIoT.
